content.title: FAQs
content.text: Summary1What is Red Bull Showrun Phoenix Presented by Ford Racing?2Where and When will the Red Bull Showrun Phoenix take place?3Do I need to purchase tickets?4How loud will this event be?5Is the event family friendly? 6Are there partnership opportunities?7What is the camera policy?8Will merch be available on site?01What is Red Bull Showrun Phoenix Presented by Ford Racing?Red Bull Showrun Phoenix presented by Ford Racing is a Formula One demonstration where an Oracle Red Bull Racing F1 car, Visa Cash App Rasing Bulls F1 car, as well as other Red Bull motorsports vehicles, will drive up and down E Jefferson street between S Central Ave & S 5th St, in a showcase of high-end performance and the drivers’ technical skills. While this is not a race, it promises to be an unforgettable experience that will make spectators’ hears race nearly as fast as the vehicles on display.02Where and When will the Red Bull Showrun Phoenix take place?Red Bull Showrun Phoenix will take place on E Jefferson Street in Downtown Phoenix, AZ, Saturday March 14th, between 1:00PM and 4:00 PM PST.03Do I need to purchase tickets?No, the event is free and open to all ages.04How loud will this event be?Oracle Red Bull Racing and Visa Cash App Racing Bulls will bring their Formula 1 Showcars with V8 engines. The show will be loud and fun. If possible, please bring and wear ear protection.05Is the event family friendly? Yes - Red Bull Showrun Phoenix is family friendly and no tickets are required. Just make sure you arrive early in order to secure a spot along our track!06Are there partnership opportunities?There are no additional partnership opportunities on site.07What is the camera policy?Personal cameras are allowed on site. Use of drones is prohibited.08Will merch be available on site?Yes, merchandize for purchase will be available on site in the Fan Zones located on site. Please visit www.redbullshopus.com for more merchandise options.
